column1: # D2 ProLLaMA transplant pilot on the anchor-restricted endpoint. Twenty-six cells.
# Scoped by the declared depth-quarter partition, not a 32-block sweep: the readout depth
# reassessment names zero seed-consistent rows for this lineage, and a likelihood endpoint
# has no folds, no projection and no readout class for a depth criterion to apply to.
# The floor and ceiling are re-derived here rather than reused from 2026-09-24, because that
# pair carries capability_transplant.py at ef762f7f... against a6f21f07... now, and a control
# at a different code digest from what it calibrates is the ambiguity a control removes.
# norm and rope are byte-identical across the two checkpoints and are not run: a zero
# contrast from an identity is not evidence that a group is insensitive.
# Every treatment cell tests sufficiency in this context. No complement cell is in this
# budget, so necessity is not tested. null is exempt from the byte-identity refusal as a
# declared control; that exemption does not weaken the refusal for any treatment cell.
# The 56-family screen rows are a support-sensitivity arm, never a filter: no cell here is
# selected on how another cell screened.
